drafted_by: TRACK1 sprint (to be reviewed by the operator)
about: The platform's named security lists (TRACK1). ONE reviewed data file: the operator edits it, then runs apps/api/scripts/security_lists_load.py. Curated lists name members by ticker with a one-line description; index lists name the fund whose holdings define them. A ticker missing from the security master is REPORTED by the loader, never created. Prices for these come from the free source (Yahoo: internal use only, never shown to members).

lists.name: S&P 500
lists.description: The S&P 500's constituents, read from State Street's daily SPY holdings file (SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust). As-of = the file's date.
lists.overlap_note: fred.sp500 (Market Indicators) is the index LEVEL; this list is its constituents.

lists.name: Russell 2000
lists.description: The Russell 2000's constituents through iShares IWM's latest SEC N-PORT filing (iShares' own file is bot-gated). N-PORT is quarterly and published with a lag: the as-of is typically 2–5 months old and is shown.
lists.overlap_note: yahoo.rut (Market Indicators) is the index LEVEL; this list is its constituents.

lists.overlap_note: yahoo.efa / yahoo.eem / yahoo.acwx in Market Indicators are index-level series; EFA and EEM here are the ETFs' own closes in the price store.

lists.name: Key benchmarks

Index LEVELS (fred.sp500, fred.nasdaq100, yahoo.rut) are in Market Indicators.
